references.text: Reiterates the prohibition against eating pork and touching their dead bodies, as they are unclean animals
Elaborates on the rules regarding uncleanness from touching dead animals and the consequences of such contact
Describes uncleanness resulting from touching the carcass of unclean animals
Prophetic condemnation of those who eat pork and other unclean meat
Judgment against those who eat pork and other abominations
Ezekiel declares that he has never eaten anything unclean or detestable
Peter's vision about clean and unclean animals, where God declares that what He has cleansed should not be called unclean
Paul teaches that no one should judge others for what they eat or drink
